observations.recommendation: cache mode REALTIME on both discovered Spine fixtures

observations.behavior: typed internal failure on cache-mode read-back mismatch; no false success

creatorLiveVerification.reason: qualification uses a loaded production scene; authoring/playback mutations were not persisted destructively

ledgerOwnership.evidenceRule: animationUsageAnalyze and bounded runtime cache-mode read-back are evidence only for the observed Spine fixture; authoring and generic Animation playback remain unqualified.

usageGuidance.inspect: Use animationUsageAnalyze first to inventory Animation, SkeletalAnimation, Spine Skeleton, and DragonBones ArmatureDisplay components.
usageGuidance.setup: Use animationRuntimeControl set_default, set_play_on_load, set_state, and set_cache_mode as separate verified operations; inspect read-back after each mutation.
usageGuidance.authoring: Use animationClipConfigure, animationTrackEdit, animationKeyframeEdit, animationEventEdit, and animationAuxCurveEdit with an explicit clipReference; the bridge selects the edit clip before dispatch.
usageGuidance.cache: Treat REALTIME/SHARED_CACHE/PRIVATE_CACHE as runtime-specific. The bridge rejects a cache request when Creator read-back does not match instead of reporting success.
usageGuidance.bounds: All animation traversal, clips, states, tracks, keys, events, and auxiliary curves are bounded by explicit schema limits.
